Usage: probe [-cfhpV] [--dry-run] [-version-json] [-cp=<cp>] [-n=N] [-o=<out>]
             [PATH]
picocli probe
      [PATH]                 positional
  -c                         single c
      -cp, --classpath=<cp>  multi-letter single-dash name
      --dry-run              print what would change
  -f, --force                skip confirmation prompts
  -h, --help                 Show this help message and exit.
  -n, --limit=N              maximum number of results to return, a
                               deliberately long description so picocli has to
                               wrap it onto continuation lines
  -o, /out, --output=<out>   three names
  -p                         single p
  -V, --version              Print version information and exit.
      -version-json          single-dash word option
